name: Bottle Lighthouse in a Foggy Salt Marsh
description: A spiral lighthouse built from stacked glass bottles stands in a misty salt marsh at dawn, reflecting soft green and gold light.
prompt: A single detailed image of a spiral lighthouse constructed from stacked glass bottles, each bottle catching faint light, standing in a misty salt marsh at sunrise. caption: Even the smallest glass can hold a way home.
